what: Plan adds larch_quiet_write_paired_pid_file to all nine Family B scripts, but four are only invoked synchronously inside another backgrounded denylist parent (ci-wait inside ship-pr.sh; step2-implement inside run-step2-dispatch.sh; review-and-fix inside run-step5-review.sh; dispatch-with-waterfall inside dispatch-plan-voters.sh). Each child would overwrite LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE with its own $$ while the Bash background job PID is the parent.
scenario_or_breakage: Monitor timeout SIGTERM targets the wrong process (e.g. ci-wait while ship-pr keeps running), leaving orphaned long runners and defeating issue #2848 pairing.
suggested_fix: Restrict the helper to orchestrator-background entrypoints only (ship-pr, run-step5-review, run-step2-dispatch, collect-agent-results, dispatch-plan-voters), or unset LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE before spawning nested denylist children; document the rule in scripts/lib-quiet.md.
